summary: Fractal web Settings shows the person's own status, interruptions, deadline clock and directive note

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change; the app uses the existing client-v0 availability operations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The section reads GET /v1/client/availability and GET /v1/client/notes on open, page focus or visibility, and reconnect; it never polls.

compatibility.detail: Against a daemon without the availability operations, or a pairing without the read scope, the section explains why it cannot show availability.

recovery.detail: Nothing is stored in the browser.
